submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective current-token detector: the pole peaks on the token being read when that token is a lexical content word from its preferred memorized subset (e.g. light, galaxy, Armstrong, function, central, asked, March, cups, time, open, final, brown, called, war, bread, black, peace, reason; graded 0.1-0.9), while staying near zero on closed-class function words, punctuation, subword continuations, and most other content words (lion, green, night, love, window) even in identical slots; preferred-token amplitude is scaled up to ~2x by supportive left context (billion boosts light 0.33 to 0.90), and every text's first token fires a content-blind floor (~0.2-0.5) that carries no signal.
